#!/usr/bin/env qore
# -*- mode: qore; indent-tabs-mode: nil -*-
# Copyright (C) 2026 Qore Technologies, s.r.o.
# applies the operations that modify a string in place to string enum lvalues; run by EnumStringInPlace-1.qtest and EnumStringInPlace-2.qtest
# generated by make-worker.py from worker-header.txt; do not edit

/** A string enum lvalue holds only the members of its enum: an operation that modifies the lvalue's string in place
    (+=, splice, extract, trim, chomp, regex substitution and transliteration) leaves a plain string, which the enum
    type refuses, so every such operation raises RUNTIME-TYPE-ERROR and leaves the lvalue unchanged, in every kind of
    lvalue, and never changes the value of the enum member.  Each check prints "name=<error>|<description>|<type>
    <value>", or "name=none|<type> <value>" if no error was raised; a check that uses the operation's value appends
    "|<type> <value>" of the value.  The same operations on a string lvalue and on lvalues of no type holding an enum
    value are controls, which they change.
*/

enum ESS : string {
    A = " a\n",
}

enum ESL : string {
    B = " a long string value that is not stored inline\n",
}

class Holder {
    public {
        ESS ess = ESS::A;
        ESL esl = ESL::B;
        ESL eslnv;
        *ESL eslonv;
        hash<string, ESL> hesl;
    }

@METHODS@
}

hashdecl HolderHash {
    ESS ess = ESS::A;
    ESL esl = ESL::B;
}

#! a string member followed by an enum member
hashdecl MixedHash {
    string s = " s ";
    ESL e = ESL::B;
}

our ESS g_ess;
our ESL g_esl;
our ESL g_eslnv;

#! returns the type and value of a value, with its line breaks escaped
string sub q(auto v) {
    return replace(sprintf("%s %y", v.fullType(), v), "\n", "\\n");
}

#! returns the type and value of a container and the types of its elements
string sub qc(auto c) {
    list<string> types = c.typeCode() == NT_HASH
        ? (map c{$1}.fullType(), keys c)
        : (map $1.fullType(), c);
    return sprintf("%s [%s]", q(c), types.join(", "));
}

#! returns the result of a check of a container that raised no error
string sub okc(auto c) {
    return "none|" + qc(c);
}

#! returns the result of a check of a container that raised an error
string sub errc(hash<ExceptionInfo> ex, auto c) {
    return sprintf("%s|%s|%s", ex.err, ex.desc, qc(c));
}

#! returns the result of a check that raised no error: the type and value of the lvalue afterwards
string sub ok(auto v) {
    return "none|" + q(v);
}

#! returns the result of a check that raised an error: the error and the type and value of the lvalue afterwards
string sub err(hash<ExceptionInfo> ex, auto v) {
    return sprintf("%s|%s|%s", ex.err, ex.desc, q(v));
}

#! returns the result of a check that raised an error in a function that it called
string sub err_out(hash<ExceptionInfo> ex) {
    return sprintf("%s|%s", ex.err, ex.desc);
}

#! prints the results of a group of checks
sub print_results(string group, hash<string, string> results) {
    foreach hash<auto> i in (results.pairIterator()) {
        printf("%s-%s=%s\n", group, i.key, i.value);
    }
}
